thread:
olivia: FYI we got a high-priority ticket from Acme — their streaming tool-call args are getting cut mid-JSON and causing tool validation errors. customer request_id=req_8f2a9c. They see mismatched braces on resume.

acme_ops: yes, reproducing on our side. Payload shows end of args like '{\"action\": \"charge\", \"amount\": 120' and then stream ends, no closing }.

samir: @olivia can you paste the raw streaming chunks (or a pcap) and the client SDK version? Also which gateway/region?

olivia: sending raw chunks below — they use our hosted endpoint in us-west-2 via a corporate proxy. SDK: js-sdk v2.4.1. Chunks:```
data: {"delta": "{\"action\": \"charge\", \"amount\": 120"}
data: {"delta": "}"}
```

devon: that looks like the proxy is injecting a keepalive or splitting mid-byte. Do we have any ingress logs for req_8f2a9c?

ingress-bot: ingest-log req_8f2a9c: upstream received 5 SSE frames, last frame length=18, connection closed by client at 2026-03-17T15:12:25Z

samir: interesting — upstream shows client close, not server. Could be corporate proxy buffering + TLS early close. Ask customer if they have an edge LB (nginx/azure-apim) doing HTTP/2 -> HTTP/1.1 conversion.

acme_ops: they confirmed an internal nginx reverse proxy with proxy_http_version 1.1 and keepalive enabled. We can try toggling chunked transfer.

olivia: reproduced locally by flipping proxy to HTTP/1.1 and limiting proxy_buffer_size to 4k — saw mid-json split. Repro steps:```
# minimal repro (nginx)
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_pass https://api.redwood.ai;
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_buffering on;
  proxy_buffers 4 1k;
}
# client: js-sdk v2.4.1 streaming call to tool with large args
```

devon: thanks. Root cause hypothesis: proxy chunk boundaries + SSE framing + our parser expecting full JSON object per tool args chunk. We should be tolerant of fragmented JSON across SSE events by buffering until a full JSON is formed.

samir: agreed — immediate support workaround: enable client-side reassembly or use ws mode. Also ask customer to set nginx proxy_buffering off or increase buffer size.

olivia: I told customer workaround + asked for their proxy config and pcap. They want an ETA for a server-side fix so they can roll back proxy change.

devon: quick fix: patch streaming parser to accumulate 'delta' fields until matching braces balance or until a complete JSON parse succeeds, then emit tool args. I'll open a small hotfix PR to the parser (cc @eng-runtime). If we can't ship in 24h, create an automated retry on tool-call parse failure to request client reconnect.

samir: please include unit tests for nested JSON and multibyte UTF-8 boundaries. Also log when fragments are reassembled and include request_id so we can audit.

olivia: noted. I've escalated to account team and scheduled a call with Acme in 90m. I'll post updates here and attach the pcap when they send it. :pray:
